name: crew-calendar
description: A calendar inside Crew. When you settle on a time in chat, Crew can save the event here, and you can add or edit events yourself. On macOS it also shows your Apple Calendar events.
highlights: Save an event from chat once you and Crew agree on a time
Ask for a draft to keep an event for later, then review and edit it in Saved drafts
Browse by day, week, month, year or list
Get scheduling suggestions in the conversations you pick, saved only after you agree
On macOS 14 or later, see Apple Calendar events and confirm each new save in a native window
useCases: Keep the times you agree on in Crew chats as calendar events, and plan your week in the same window.
configuration: No account or sign-in is needed. Scheduling suggestions need one hook registered under Agent features → Hooks, and the app shows the exact command. Remove that hook before you uninstall. On macOS 14 or later, allow Calendar access to see Apple Calendar events.
author: Jihun Kim
